name: Filen WebDAV
description: Filen WebDAV is Filen's official WebDAV server for its end-to-end encrypted cloud storage. In proxy mode it acts as a gateway for several Filen accounts, each client signing in with its own credentials. Any WebDAV client, such as Finder, Windows Explorer, rclone or Infuse, can mount the storage.

notes.text: Sign in with your Filen email as username and password=<password> as password; append &twoFactorAuthentication=<code> if 2FA is on.
Credentials travel as HTTP Basic Auth over plain HTTP. Keep it on a trusted network; a TLS reverse proxy protects credentials in transit but does not make public exposure safe.
